items.reason_zh: 评测对象是编码 Agent 构造的压缩权重和对应推理实现。多轮 PPL 反馈改进的是外部模型研发产物，正文未显示 Agent 自身的提示、工具或控制程序被反馈修改并继承。可归一般 RSI / AI 研发评测，排除出 Harness 专题；不能把推理代码等同 Agent Harness。
items.summary_en: CompressionBench evaluates whether coding agents can construct compressed weights and executable inference implementations under storage and time budgets, with independent artifact verification. Its feedback loop improves model-compression artifacts rather than the agent harness, so it belongs to general RSI / AI R&D evaluation, outside the Harness topic.
items.summary_zh: CompressionBench 评测编码 Agent 能否在存储与时间预算下构造压缩权重及推理实现，并以独立测试验证产物。PPL 反馈指导的是模型压缩研发过程，没有展示 Agent 自身 Harness 的反馈演化，因此归一般 RSI / AI 研发评测，不计入 Harness 篇数。

items.reason_zh: 理论比较达尔文、拉马克及 Agent 主导演化的适应速度、搜索成本与评价目标错设。DGM/AIDE² 只是动机及相关工作；形式化对象是一般继承行为和候选模型/Agent，而非专门研究外部 Harness 工件的反馈演化。归一般 RSI 理论/安全，排除出 Harness 专题。
items.summary_en: This theoretical study compares natural selection, inherited learning, and agent-directed search, including their adaptation rates, costs, and behavior under a misspecified evaluator. It models general inherited behavior rather than specifically the feedback-driven evolution of external harness artifacts.
items.summary_zh: 本文用一般演化模型比较自然选择、可继承学习和 Agent 自主搜索的适应速度及成本，并分析评价目标错设时更强搜索为何可能更快偏离真实目标。研究并不专门限定外部 Harness 工件，归一般 RSI 理论与安全讨论。

items.reason_zh: Harness 专项评测：明确区分 executor 修改任务产物与 improver 修改 executor / 自己的提示、工具和工作流；轨迹与评估结果驱动下一轮 Harness，并保持模型权重、评估器和划分固定。另有冻结 Harness 配对消融，因此不只是通用任务产物评测。
items.summary_en: Flex-RSI separates solution improvement from harness improvement: an executor edits the task solution, while an improver uses trajectories and results to revise the executor and its own prompts, tools, and workflow for later rounds. Model weights, evaluators, and data splits stay fixed, and the final solution is evaluated on hidden test data. Paired frozen-harness runs study the contribution of harness editing. Uneven task coverage and generally single runs limit claims of robustness or cross-task transfer.
items.summary_zh: Flex-RSI 将任务解的改进与 Harness 改进分开：executor 修改解，improver 根据轨迹和结果改写 executor 及自身的提示、工具与工作流，后续轮次继续使用更新后的 Harness。模型权重、评估器和数据划分固定，最终解在隐藏测试集评分；论文另用冻结 Harness 配对运行检验 Harness 编辑的贡献。应归 Harness 专项评测，但各模型任务覆盖不齐、通常每格单次运行，不能据此夸大稳健性或跨任务迁移。

items.reason_zh: 固定模型下，Agent 根据当前执行轨迹触发复审，直接改写工具、控制流和状态管理代码；kernel 验证 commit 后热加载，更新后的 Harness 控制后续执行与后续复审，具备反馈驱动的程序工件更新和跨改进轮次保留。独立跨任务迁移未证实，不写成泛化成功；PerfRace 上的项目代码优化与 Harness 更新须区分。
items.summary_en: BOXBOX lets an agent request reviews and rewrite its executable harness in response to difficulties during a long-running task. A kernel validates the changes and hot-reloads the runtime while preserving execution context; the revised harness governs later execution and reviews. PerfRace comparisons use matched task-time budgets against frozen, offline-evolved, and externally controlled harness baselines. This supports within-task inheritance across improvement rounds; independent cross-task transfer remains unknown and equal time does not imply equal dollar cost.
items.summary_zh: BOXBOX 让 Agent 在长时任务中根据执行困难主动复审并改写自己的可执行 Harness。kernel 验证改动后保留上下文、热加载新运行时，后续执行和复审继续使用新版。PerfRace 上与固定 Harness、离线 Harness Evolution 和外部控制的 Harness Scaling 比较，使用相同任务时间预算；这是任务内跨轮 Harness 演化证据，独立跨任务迁移仍为 unknown，不能把时间预算相同写成费用完全相同。
